question: What act of transmission is claimed to have been completed for the addressee with respect to the practice of the soul?
premises: The practice of the soul is the object in question.
It is said to have been told to the addressee.
inference: This practice of the soul has been told to you, O Bhairavī.
uncertainties: Full content of the practice not repeated in this verse
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
